## TRA Timeline

#### Chapter 11 and Plan formation

- 2014-04-29: EFH Corp., EFCH, EFIH, and T-side debtors file Chapter 11 (Case No. 14-10979, Bankr. D. Del.)
- 2015-08-09: First Plan Support Agreement enumerates contingent Spin-Off Tax Receivable Agreement
- 2016-07-12: Plan Sponsor transitions from Hunt to NextEra-led alternative
- 2016-08-29: NextEra-track Plan and Disclosure Statement; TRA still contingent

#### TCEH emergence and TRA execution

- 2016-10-03: TCEH Effective Date; TEX Energy LLC executes TRA with American Stock Transfer & Trust Co. as Transfer Agent for former TCEH First Lien Creditors; TEX Energy LLC converts into TCEH Corp.
- 2016-10-04: Executed TRA filed as Ex 99.2 to joint 8-K (co-filers EFH, EFCH, EFIH, EFIH Finance, TCEH)

#### EFCH ceases reporting

- 2016-12-28: Last EFCH-filed 8-K (joint filing attaching Sixth Amended Joint Plan); EFCH ceases reporting; TRA continues at TCEH Corp. off-EDGAR for this CIK

## Explanation

Energy Future Competitive Holdings Co. LLC is a predecessor entity rather than a TRA obligor in its own right. EFCH was the T-side parent holding company of the post-2007 LBO consolidated group; together with EFH Corp. and the T-side debtor subsidiaries it filed Chapter 11 on April 29, 2014. Under the Sixth Amended Joint Plan of Reorganization, EFCH and TCEH contributed operating assets to TEX Energy LLC, which then converted into TCEH Corp. and was distributed to TCEH First Lien Creditors on the October 3, 2016 TCEH Effective Date. The same-day executed Tax Receivable Agreement pays 85% of cash tax savings from Plan-related basis step-ups (including the PrefCo Preferred Stock Sale), the La Frontera asset basis acquired in November 2015, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments; TRA Rights are held book-entry by American Stock Transfer & Trust Company for former TCEH First Lien Creditors. The contract document under EFCH's CIK is byte-identical to copies under EFH Corp. (0001023291) and EFIH (0001445146); the operative obligor is TCEH Corp. (separate CIK, outside this directory). EFCH's last filing is December 28, 2016 and the TRA's subsequent fate at TCEH Corp. is not visible from this CIK. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the cross-CIK reconciliation.
